2124247430761791718.en_summary: It’s the perfect closed loop: $NVDA spends years and billions inventing the best AI chips so it can sell them. U.S. government says don’t sell the good ones to that one country that really wants them. China decides it would quite like the good ones after all (for data centers that may or may not end up next to radar and missile factories). So the chips take the scenic route through Malaysian subsidiaries, shell companies, and a former executive. Everybody gets what they asked for: the company made money, the government got its rules, China got the chips, and the rest of us got a multi-year investigation plus a resignation.
2124247430761791718.zh_summary: 這是完美的閉環：$NVDA 花費多年和數十億發明最好的 AI 晶片以便出售。美國政府說不要把好的賣給那個真正想要的國家。中國決定它其實很想要好的（用於可能或不在雷達和導彈工廠旁邊的數據中心）。所以晶片透過馬來西亞子公司、殼公司和前高管走風景路線。每個人都得到他們要求的：公司賺了錢，政府得到了規則，中國得到了晶片，我們其他人得到了多年調查加上辭職。
